about.title: Dos Palos Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Dos Palos is a small place, about 5,125 people, and when one of them dies in a crash the loss is felt along Frank Avenue, Elgin Avenue and the stretch of Route 33 that runs through town. Public records for 2025 show four injury collisions in the city, five people hurt, and one traffic death. That single number is a family. If yours is that family, LawProactive can connect you, at no cost, with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death claims in Merced County. California limits who may bring this kind of claim: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. The general filing window is two years from the date of death, and it grows shorter if a government entity is involved. A wrongful death case is civil and stands apart from any criminal charges. Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the love, companionship and guidance that cannot be replaced. Attorneys in our network work on contingency.

whyChoose.title: Why Dos Palos Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California gives standing first to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, then to certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can confirm where you fit before anything is filed.

items.title: Respect for the two-year clock
items.desc: Most wrongful death claims must be brought within two years of the date of death, and claims against a public agency have a much shorter window. Connecting early protects your options.

items.title: A separate path from the criminal case
items.desc: Even if a driver faces charges, your family's civil claim is its own action with its own standards. It can pursue funeral costs, lost support, and the loss of companionship and guidance regardless of what happens in criminal court.

items.question: My relative was killed on SR-33 near Dos Palos. Does it matter that it's a state highway?
items.answer: It can. If the condition of the roadway or a public agency's conduct played a role, a government claim may need to be filed well before the usual two-year deadline. An attorney can look at the facts of the crash and tell you which deadlines apply. That is one reason it helps to reach out sooner rather than later.

items.question: The other driver is being prosecuted. Do we have to wait for that to finish?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil matter and runs independently of any criminal case in Merced County. Your family can move forward on its own timeline, and the outcome of the criminal case does not decide the civil claim.

items.question: What losses can a Dos Palos family actually recover?
items.answer: California allows recovery for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have contributed over time, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Every family's situation is different, so an attorney will walk through what applies to yours. LawProactive's connection is free, and network attorneys charge no fee unless there is a recovery.
